items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...would you say that our great black piano player that we consider one of the finest, especially in New York -- Hank Jones -- don't you think he's got -- [INTERVIEWEE] Who? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh.

ctx.x: Don't you think that -- Hank Jones and Chitteson had that smooth type of playing -- don't you agree with me?
Yeah, they were smooth piano players. Hank. And he's got some band now, doesn't he?
He's doing Ain't Misbehavin', he's the musical director of Ain't Misbehavin', Hank Jones is.
